assertions.assertion: The patient has a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks
The patient has a history of unspecified cardiac arrhythmia
The unspecified cardiac arrhythmia is coded I49.9
The patient presents with intermittent dizziness
The dizziness and palpitations are poorly correlated with standard ECG findings
The patient is being evaluated for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation or other intermittent dysrhythmias
The transient neurological symptoms are attributed to intermittent dysrhythmias
Cardiac event monitoring is clinically indicated
The cardiac event monitoring is coded CPT 93271
The study is medically necessary to detect intermittent dysrhythmias responsible for the patient's transient cerebral ischemic attacks
The transient cerebral ischemic attacks cannot be reliably identified on routine ECG
